messages:
Alex G.: Morning team: quick triage — 63 open tickets, 3 P1s (billing retry loop, embeddings regression, scheduled export failure). Spike started ~07:20 UTC; looks like a client-side retry loop plus a failed background job.
Priya S.: I'll grab the billing P1 and loop in payments. ETA 20m.
Noah R.: Taking the embeddings regression. Seeing higher latencies and some timeouts for the small-embedding endpoint. Reproduced locally with synthetic load.
support-bot: incident created #INC-2026-512 — assigned to Noah R.
Alex G.: Can someone update the external macro for the billing issue to note the workaround (pause automated retries) and add the request-id troubleshooting step?
Sam T.: I'll draft a short macro. Suggest adding: "If you're using SDK, set retry_policy to exponential with jitter" and a line about attaching request-id. Will post PR.
Maria L.: Quick heads-up: I have a CR blocking embed rollback PR — https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/320 — could use review from Priya or Sam.
Priya S.: Reviewing now, focus on tone and the workaround steps.
Noah R.: Early findings: embeddings node pool is saturated due to a batch job that misconfigured batch_size=2048. I'm throttling that job and requeueing smaller batches.
Alex G.: Thanks. If batch jobs are misbehaving, please add an automated guard in the job runner to cap batch_size at 512 and emit a metric.
Noah R.: On it; I'll file a tiny patch and tag eng-runtime for a quick telemetry feed so we can alert before saturation.
eng-runtime-oncall: ACK — will add short-term alert for batch CPU > 85% and look at kernel oom events.
Sam T.: Macro draft posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/321 — includes troubleshooting bullets and a short customer-friendly explanation. @Priya S. PTAL.
Priya S.: Left a couple copy edits. Also added a short note about expected propagation time for retries (5-10m) so customers know when to resubmit.
Alex G.: Ops note: queue likely elevated for 1-2 hours while retries trickle out. If open tickets > 90, call for burst coverage.
Maria L.: I'm available to take a 45m shift starting 09:30 UTC if needed.
Noah R.: Update 25m: throttling the batch job brought embed latency down ~60%. Timeouts largely gone. Will monitor for 30m before marking P1 resolved.
Alex G.: Thanks. Reminder: when you update macros, include a short "what we changed" line so we can paste it into inbound replies.
Sam T.: Added that line to PR comments.
support-bot: macro merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/321 — published.
Priya S.: P1 (billing) transferred to payments at 08:05 UTC; customer workaround applied. P1 (embeddings) marked mitigated at 08:40 UTC. Queue at 28 open now.
Alex G.: Closing thread — great job. If anything flares, reopen or start a new thread. :thumbsup: 
Priya S.: Closing notes: updated internal triage doc with new guardrails and a one-liner macro template.
Noah R.: Final: monitoring passes, no further action. Closing incidents.
